meaning: Focused local source cases, before the remote full validation; this does not replace pending browser engines.

limitations: Fixtures use the pinned technical catalogue and dated TCG application snapshot, not independently authenticated universal rulings.
Initial Main Deck fields are declared physical assumptions; Spark proper history is established by executed procedures and fresh replay.
QA-only altered states test rejection and are not certified game lines.
Only registered material profiles, responses, Main Zone destinations and timing are tested; general summon negation, priority and all simultaneous triggers remain outside scope.
Competitive scoring remains provisional by user request.
